components.name: Story Card with Leaf Light
components.description: Solid shade panel over the 3D scene; gold leaf light along the top margin and right edge, driven by --sx, --sy and --sun.
components.html:
Watch your floor go up.

Planned dates look planned; finished work looks finished.
components.css: .ds-card { --sx: 0px; --sy: 0px; --sun: .8; position: relative; width: 400px; padding: 56px 30px 24px; background: #10221f; color: #e9e9d8; border: 1.5px solid #22413a; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.55); } .ds-card::before, .ds-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; background: url('../assets/chinar-leaves.jpg') calc(50% + var(--sx)) 30% / 640px auto; filter: grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(2.6) hue-rotate(-8deg) brightness(1.05) contrast(1.25); mix-blend-mode: screen; pointer-events: none; opacity: calc(var(--sun) * .95); transition: background-position .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), opacity .6s; } .ds-card::before { left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 40px; } .ds-card::after { top: 40px; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 22px; background-position: calc(30% + var(--sx)) calc(60% + var(--sy)); } .ds-card > * { position: relative; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 16px; font: 700 2.2rem/1.04 Geologica, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'SHRP' 100; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: rgba(233,233,216,.76); font: 400 1rem/1.55 'Golos Text', sans-serif; max-width: 40ch; }

narrative.northStar: Under the Chinar Avenue in November
narrative.overview:
The interface stands in the shade of a Tashkent plane-tree avenue late in the year. Light grounds are the plane tree's camouflage bark, carried as a real photograph under a flat bone tint; text, panels, header and the bands between sections are deep shade ink. Chinar gold is the only warm colour and it behaves like sunlight: it lands where the buyer acts or has chosen. Aryk teal belongs to water, routes and "available".

The system is hard and economical. One line weight (1.5 px) draws every rule, border, focus ring and underline. Corners are square or a 2 px hair. Space comes from a 24 px module and its multiples. Panels are solid, never glass; nothing blurs. The 3D scene carries the atmosphere, and the UI over it stays legible, opaque and still.

The signature is sunlight through leaves: a backlit chinar-leaf photograph, turned to gold light, runs along the top margin and right edge of the dark panels. On the scroll story it is driven by the scene's sun, so it moves with the sun's azimuth and dims with its height.
keyCharacteristics: Bark-and-shade palette with gold as the single warm signal.
One 1.5 px line weight for every stroke.
Square or 2 px corners; solid opaque panels.
24 px module; sections separated by 48 px solid shade bands.
Geologica with sharp terminals (SHRP 100) for display and numbers, Golos Text for reading.
Gold leaf-light along panel margins, coupled to the 3D sun.

rules.name: The One Warm Colour Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only where the buyer acts or has chosen: primary action, chosen floor, selected flat, active chapter, slider thumb. Selected toggles that are not the buyer's decision (language, season, instalment term) invert to bone on shade instead.

rules.name: The Water-Only Teal Rule
rules.body: Teal means water, routes or "available". It is never a button, link or decoration colour.

rules.name: The Sharp Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every figure the buyer compares (floor, price, area, date, time, phone) is set in Geologica with tabular lining numerals.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels and no tracked-out small caps; labels carry at most .04em tracking.

rules.name: The Solid Panel Rule
rules.body: Anything over the scene is opaque shade with a shade-edge border; the scene never shows through UI.

dos: Do draw every rule, border, underline and focus ring at 1.5 px.
Do reserve gold for the primary action, chosen floor, selected flat, active chapter and slider thumb.
Do set compared figures in Geologica with tabular lining numerals and SHRP 100.
Do keep panels over the 3D scene solid shade with a shade-edge border.
Do separate bark sections from the previous section with a 48 px solid shade band.
Do carry the bark ground as the photo under a flat 80% bone tint, falling back to bone.
Do use the leaf light on dark panels only, along the top margin and right edge, never behind copy.
donts: Don't use glass, backdrop blur or decorative colour gradients; the only gradients are the flat bark tint and the planned-schedule hatch.
Don't use teal for actions, links or decoration.
Don't use hard offset shadows; shadows are soft and only over the scene or under the dialog.
Don't set uppercase or widely tracked labels.
